title: Isolated-region protection and safe-fallback with KV-cache drain (hotfix)
author: Priya Kannan
release_notes: Hotfix: detect isolated (islanded) regions and perform a safe fallback that drains per-request KV cache to avoid serving stale prefix-anchored responses. Includes metric/alerting and a guarded rollout; no API change.
description: Motivation: During a cross-region incident we observed an "islanded" region scenario where the control plane-to-node heartbeats transiently lost egress but local model processes remained healthy. That caused the routing layer to continue directing requests to a region that could not reach shared KV/cache invalidation, resulting in stale prefix reuse and increased error rates for model variants dependent on external context. This PR implements a detection-and-protect hotfix: (1) islanded region detector with conservative hysteresis, (2) a 'safe-fallback' routing policy that redirects new requests to healthy regions while letting in-flight streams finish, and (3) a KV-cache drain path for the local runtime to evict prefix/KV entries that could become stale when the region is isolated. The change is intentionally additive and guarded by an operator-configurable feature flag. Summary of changes: added coordinator/region_health.go for island detection and propagation of islanded state to the router, implemented runtime/cache/kv_drain.go which exposes a non-blocking KV drain hook used during safe-fallback transitions, updated runtime/router to consult the islanded state and trigger steady-fallback instead of immediate hard cutover, added Prometheus alert rules and dashboards to observability/alerts/prometheus_rules.yml, added an operational runbook docs/operational-runbooks/islanded-region.md, added e2e test e2e-tests/region-failover.test.ts that simulates control plane egress loss, and updated helm chart default(s) to keep the feature flag off by default. Commits: ["b8c3f4b - coordinator: region health and islanded state propagation","2f9d020 - runtime: non-blocking KV-cache drain hook and drain worker","43e7a12 - router: safe-fallback policy and steady handoff logic","a1b2c3d - observability: islanded-region alerting and dashboard tweaks","d4e5f6a - docs: runbook for islanded-region response","f7a8b9c - tests: e2e simulating islanded region and reroute behaviour"]. Files changed (high level): ["coordinator/region_health.go","runtime/cache/kv_drain.go","runtime/router/router.go","observability/prometheus_rules.yml","docs/operational-runbooks/islanded-region.md","e2e-tests/region-failover.test.ts","charts/redwood/values.yaml","pkg/flags/feature_flags.go"].

--- a/runtime/cache/kv_drain.go
+++ b/runtime/cache/kv_drain.go
@@ -1,6 +1,34 @@
+package cache
+
+// DrainNonBlocking schedules an asynchronous eviction pass for per-request prefix entries.
+func DrainNonBlocking(ctx context.Context, region string) {
+    // avoid blocking critical request paths; run in limited worker pool
+    go func() {
+        // evict only prefix-indexed entries older than safeWindow
+        evictStalePrefixes(ctx, region)
+    }()
+}
testing_and_ci: Unit tests added for island detection and kv drain logic; e2e sim simulates control-plane egress blackout using test harness. CI initially reported a flaky e2e failure (test 'region-failover.spec should not drop active streams') on first run, flake traced to timing in test harness; test re-run passed and full pipeline green. Performance tests: added microbenchmark for drain worker that shows <2ms median overhead when scheduled. Security: no new network scopes required; feature flag default false for operator opt-in. Rollout plan: feature flag off by default; deploy to canary region group A for 24h with elevated sampling, then staged rollout across regions with automatic rollback if error budget breach >1.5x for 1h. Operators can force immediate activation via helm value or Console toggle. Rollback: removing the feature is safe because handlers are non-blocking; draining is best-effort and idempotent. Observability and alerts: new alert islanded_region_detected fires when a region enters islanded state for >30s; dashboards show islanded_count, reroute_rate, kv_drain_ops. Backwards compatibility: no public API changes; config defaults keep previous behaviour unless explicitly enabled. Migration: none required. Docs: new runbook describes detection thresholds, how to inspect drain status and manual fallback triggers. Review conversation summary: Ava Chen: "Can the drain accidentally evict useful cached prefixes (eg long-lived session tokens)?" Reply (Priya): "Drain only targets prefix-indexed per-request entries older than a conservative safeWindow and skips persistent session buckets; added unit test to validate this safeguard." Carlos Mendes: "Is the steady fallback gradual enough to avoid request storms in healthy regions?" Reply (Priya): "Router uses steady handoff that caps per-second reroutes and ramps over 10s windows; added e2e to verify ramp behaviour." Satoshi Yamada: "Please ensure alerts are low-noise before enabling globally." Reply (Priya): "Added 30s hysteresis and requires 3 consecutive samples; alert tuned to fire on persistent conditions only." Approvals: Ava Chen approved with comment "LGTM with follow-up to watch alerting noise". Carlos Mendes gave thumbs up. Merge: merged via squash on 2026-03-07 after CI green and 2 approvals. Notes: This PR is a focused operational hotfix to prevent stale-cache exposure and reduce blast radius during transient network islands. It is intentionally conservative and guarded by flags; follow-up work tracked in ENG-4932 will add simulated chaos tests and tighter integration with autoscaler to avoid capacity pressure during reroutes.
